title: Copy text or command output to the clipboard
summary: Use xsel to send text or the output of a command to the system clipboard. This is useful for automating copy actions in scripts or when you want to copy something without using the mouse.

aliases.text: скопировать текст в буфер обмена linux

steps.explain: Pipe the text or command output into xsel with the input and clipboard flags to copy it.

placeholders.name: TEXT
placeholders.description: The text or command output you want to copy.

alternatives.explain: Copy the contents of a specific file to the clipboard.

placeholders.name: FILE
placeholders.description: Path to the file whose contents you want to copy.
